notes.title: MicroSStep_patchnote_2025/03/21
notes.content:
We have made some balance adjustments, which we report here.

3/14
The basic status of the main character Cross/Akaho has been revised upward.
The attack power of enemy bullets has been lowered.

3/21
The hardening of the main character when hit by enemy bullets has been relaxed.
Fixed a bug that made Quest 6 of Cross nearly impossible to complete.

Thank you very much for playing our game.
We look forward to your continued support.

notes.title: MicroSStep_PatchNote_2025/03/10
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that in rare cases, the achievements for completing Story 1 and 2 were not unlocked.
If the conditions are met, the achievement will be unlocked on the start screen.
(There is no need to clear the corresponding story again!)

If you still encounter the glitch, we would appreciate it if you could contact us.

Also, we are currently working on the next update!
Please wait a while for Shirona's entry.
